title.zh-TW: 調整卡片透明度，黑洞與水族箱背景不再被遮擋
title.en: Adjusted card opacity lets the black hole and aquarium backgrounds shine through

body.zh-TW: 你的主題背景不會再被卡片擋到看不見了。以前在使用「黑洞」或「午夜水族館」這兩個主題面板時，卡片本身的顏色太濃、毛玻璃效果太霧，導致黑洞的吸積盤，或者水族館裡游來游去的魚和水母，幾乎全被蓋住。現在系統大幅調降了卡片的透明度與模糊效果，讓背景裡的漂亮圖案能清楚透出來，同時也確保卡片上的字一樣好讀。此外，專案的 README 說明書也參考了各大優秀開源工具的標準重新排版，並補齊了所有最新功能的介紹。就像你家新買了一個超美的魚缸當隔間牆，結果原本裝的毛玻璃太厚，什麼魚都看不到；現在換成了更清透的玻璃，不但保留了隔間的隱私（字一樣好讀），還能清楚欣賞魚群游動。
body.en: Your gorgeous themed backgrounds will no longer be completely obscured by the data cards on top of them. Previously, when you used the "Black Hole" or "Midnight Aquarium" panels, the card opacity was so heavy and the background blur so intense that the black hole's accretion disk, or the aquarium's fish and jellyfish, were virtually buried. The system has now significantly lowered both the opacity and the blur on these cards, allowing the beautiful canvas art to shine through clearly while keeping the text completely readable. Additionally, the project's README manual has been thoroughly restructured following best practices from top open-source tools, and now includes a complete inventory of all current features. It's like installing a stunning aquarium as a room divider, only to realize the frosted glass you used was so thick you couldn't see the fish; now you've swapped it for crystal-clear glass, keeping the separation of the room intact while letting you admire the vibrant marine life.

items.original:
**Black hole panel: the black hole was barely visible behind the cards**: card surface opacity (0.28 → 0.14) and backdrop blur (4px → 1.5px) were heavy enough to bury the accretion disk and event horizon drawn on the background canvas. Both were lowered so the black hole stays clearly visible through the cards.
**Midnight aquarium panel: fish and jellyfish were hidden behind the cards**: same treatment as the black hole panel — card surface opacity (0.22/0.28 → 0.13/0.17) and backdrop blur (12px → 2.5px) lowered so the aquarium life stays visible while text remains readable.
**README overhauled in both languages**: restructured along conventions surveyed from well-maintained open-source developer tools, with a complete inventory of current features.
